import fsspec, xarray as xr, numpy as np, datetime as dt, warnings, time

fs = fsspec.filesystem('onedata')
f = fs.open('icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s2z/sst_s2.nc', 'rb')
ds = xr.open_dataset(f, engine='h5netcdf')
sst = ds['analysed_sst']
tvals = ds.time.values
lat = ds.latitude.values; lon = ds.longitude.values
latmask = (lat >= 54.13) & (lat <= 55.33); lonmask = (lon >= 14.67) & (lon <= 15.87)
la = np.where(latmask)[0]; lo = np.where(lonmask)[0]
lat_sl = slice(la[0], la[-1]+1); lon_sl = slice(lo[0], lo[-1]+1)

# baseline slab dates: 1991-12-27 .. 2003-01-05 (covers every +/-5-day window around 1992-2002 dates)
b0 = np.searchsorted(tvals, np.datetime64('1991-12-27'))
b1 = np.searchsorted(tvals, np.datetime64('2003-01-05'), 'right')
print("baseline idx", b0, b1, "n days", b1-b0, tvals[b0], tvals[b1-1])
base_D = tvals[b0].astype('datetime64[D]')

t0 = time.time()
basel = sst.isel(time=slice(b0,b1), latitude=lat_sl, longitude=lon_sl).values.astype(np.float64)
print("baseline read %.1fs shape %s" % (time.time()-t0, basel.shape))
print("baseline SST range (K): %.3f .. %.3f" % (np.nanmin(basel), np.nanmax(basel)))

# centers: for doy d in year y  (leap-safe): d<=59 -> Jan1+(d-1); d>=61 -> Mar1+(d-61)
years = list(range(1992, 2003))
def center_date(y, d):
    if d <= 59:  return dt.date(y,1,1) + dt.timedelta(days=d-1)
    if d >= 61:  return dt.date(y,3,1) + dt.timedelta(days=d-61)
    return None  # d == 60 (Feb 29): no pool of its own

thr = np.full((366, 60, 60), np.nan)
clim = np.full((366, 60, 60), np.nan)
pool_sizes = []
t0 = time.time()
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
    for d in range(1, 367):
        if d == 60: continue
        ks = []
        for y in years:
            c = center_date(y, d)
            k = int((np.datetime64(c, 'D') - base_D).astype(int))
            ks.extend(range(k-5, k+6))
        ks = np.array(sorted(set(ks)))
        assert ks.min() >= 0 and ks.max() < (b1-b0)
        pool_sizes.append(len(ks))
        pool = basel[ks]                       # (n_pool, 60, 60) float64
        thr[d-1] = np.nanquantile(pool, 0.9, axis=0, method='hazen')
        clim[d-1] = np.nanmean(pool, axis=0)
print("pool loop %.1fs; pool sizes min/max: %d/%d" % (time.time()-t0, min(pool_sizes), max(pool_sizes)))

# day 60 <- mean of day 59 and 61 (before smoothing)
thr[59] = 0.5*(thr[58] + thr[60])
clim[59] = 0.5*(clim[58] + clim[60])

# unweighted centred 31-day moving mean, wrapping modulo 366
offs = np.arange(-15, 16)
sidx = (np.arange(366)[:, None] + offs[None, :]) % 366
thr_sm = thr[sidx].mean(axis=1)
clim_sm = clim[sidx].mean(axis=1)

print("thr_sm NaN cells:", int(np.isnan(thr_sm).any(axis=0).sum()), " clim_sm NaN cells:", int(np.isnan(clim_sm).any(axis=0).sum()))
print("thr_sm range: %.3f .. %.3f K" % (np.nanmin(thr_sm), np.nanmax(thr_sm)))
print("clim_sm range: %.3f .. %.3f K" % (np.nanmin(clim_sm), np.nanmax(clim_sm)))
# sample: a central cell, days 150-160
print("sample thr_sm[149:160, 30, 30]:", np.round(thr_sm[149:160, 30, 30], 3).tolist())
print("sample clim_sm[149:160, 30, 30]:", np.round(clim_sm[149:160, 30, 30], 3).tolist())

np.savez_compressed('/tmp/mhw_interm.npz', thr_sm=thr_sm, clim_sm=clim_sm)
print("saved /tmp/mhw_interm.npz")

import fsspec, xarray as xr, numpy as np, datetime as dt, json, os, time

interm = np.load('/tmp/mhw_interm.npz')
thr_sm = interm['thr_sm']  # (366, 60, 60) float64
clim_sm = interm['clim_sm']

fs = fsspec.filesystem('onedata')
f = fs.open('icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s2z/sst_s2.nc', 'rb')
ds = xr.open_dataset(f, engine='h5netcdf')
sst = ds['analysed_sst']
tvals = ds.time.values
lat = ds.latitude.values; lon = ds.longitude.values
latmask = (lat >= 54.13) & (lat <= 55.33); lonmask = (lon >= 14.67) & (lon <= 15.87)
la = np.where(latmask)[0]; lo = np.where(lonmask)[0]
lat_sl = slice(la[0], la[-1]+1); lon_sl = slice(lo[0], lo[-1]+1)

t0i = np.searchsorted(tvals, np.datetime64('2008-06-01'))
t1i = np.searchsorted(tvals, np.datetime64('2008-08-31'), 'right')
tdates = tvals[t0i:t1i].astype('datetime64[D]')
ndays = len(tdates)
print("target days:", ndays, tdates[0], "->", tdates[-1])

t0 = time.time()
sst_t = sst.isel(time=slice(t0i,t1i), latitude=lat_sl, longitude=lon_sl).values.astype(np.float64)
print("target read %.1fs shape %s" % (time.time()-t0, sst_t.shape))

# sea cells: finite SST on every day of the target period
sea = np.isfinite(sst_t).all(axis=0)
print("sea cells:", int(sea.sum()))

# day-of-year mapping by month/day (leap-safe, 1..366)
def doy_of(date64):
    d = dt.date.fromisoformat(str(date64))
    if d.month == 2 and d.day == 29: return 60
    return (d - dt.date(d.year,1,1)).days + 1
doy_idx = np.array([doy_of(d) - 1 for d in tdates])   # 0-based into 366
print("doy_idx first/last:", doy_idx[:3].tolist(), doy_idx[-3:].tolist())

# hot: SST >= threshold for that doy (in kelvin as stored)
thr_t = thr_sm[doy_idx]          # (92, 60, 60)
hot = (sst_t >= thr_t)
hot &= sea[None, :, :]
print("hot day-cell count:", int(hot.sum()), " hot fraction of sea cells:", hot.sum()/sea.sum()/ndays)

# per-cell MHW: runs of >=5 consecutive hot days, gaps of 1-2 non-hot days joined
nT, nY, nX = hot.shape
mhw = np.zeros_like(hot, dtype=bool)
runs5 = 0; joined = 0; final_runs = 0
for yy in range(nY):
    for xx in range(nX):
        h = hot[:, yy, xx]
        if not h.any(): continue
        # initial runs >= 5
        d = np.diff(h.astype(np.int8))
        starts = np.where(d == 1)[0] + 1
        ends = np.where(d == -1)[0] + 1
        if h[0]: starts = np.r_[0, starts]
        if h[-1]: ends = np.r_[ends, nT]
        lens = ends - starts
        keep = lens >= 5
        runs5 += int(keep.sum())
        rs = starts[keep]; re = ends[keep]
        if len(rs) == 0: continue
        # join runs separated by 1-2 non-hot days
        ms = [rs[0]]; me = [re[0]]
        for s, e in zip(rs[1:], re[1:]):
            gap = s - me[-1]      # non-hot days between
            if 1 <= gap <= 2:
                joined += 1
                me[-1] = e
            else:
                ms.append(s); me.append(e)
        final_runs += len(ms)
        for s, e in zip(ms, me):
            mhw[s:e, yy, xx] = True

print("initial runs>=5:", runs5, " gaps joined:", joined, " final per-cell MHWs:", final_runs)
print("mhw day-cell count:", int(mhw.sum()))

# regional: active day = at least one sea cell inside a per-cell MHW
active = mhw.any(axis=(1,2))
print("active days:", int(active.sum()), "/", ndays)
vals, cnts = np.unique(active, return_counts=True)
print(dict(zip(vals.tolist(), cnts.tolist())))
ar = active.astype(np.int8); dd = np.diff(ar)
ev_starts = np.where(dd == 1)[0] + 1
ev_ends = np.where(dd == -1)[0]
if active[0]: ev_starts = np.r_[0, ev_starts]
if active[-1]: ev_ends = np.r_[ev_ends, ndays-1]
events = [(str(tdates[s]), str(tdates[e])) for s, e in zip(ev_starts, ev_ends)]
print("regional events:", events)
print("event lengths:", [int((np.datetime64(e)-np.datetime64(s)).astype(int))+1 for s,e in events])

np.savez_compressed('/tmp/mhw_mask.npz', mhw=mhw.astype(np.uint8))
print("saved mask")

import fsspec, xarray as xr, numpy as np, datetime as dt, warnings, time

fs = fsspec.filesystem('onedata')
f = fs.open('icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s2z/sst_s2.nc', 'rb')
ds = xr.open_dataset(f, engine='h5netcdf')
sst = ds['analysed_sst']; tvals = ds.time.values
lat = ds.latitude.values; lon = ds.longitude.values
la = np.where((lat>=54.13)&(lat<=55.33))[0]; lo = np.where((lon>=14.67)&(lon<=15.87))[0]
b0 = int(np.searchsorted(tvals, np.datetime64('1991-12-27')))
b1 = int(np.searchsorted(tvals, np.datetime64('2003-01-05'), 'right'))
base_D = tvals[b0].astype('datetime64[D]')

t0=time.time()
basel = sst.isel(time=slice(b0,b1), latitude=slice(la[0],la[-1]+1), longitude=slice(lo[0],lo[-1]+1)).values.astype(np.float64)
print("baseline re-read %.1fs" % (time.time()-t0))

# manual Hazen (type 5) quantile
def hazen_q(x, p=0.9):
    x = np.sort(x[~np.isnan(x)])
    n = x.size
    if n == 0: return np.nan
    pos = n*p + 0.5 - 1.0
    if pos <= 0: return float(x[0])
    if pos >= n-1: return float(x[-1])
    l = int(np.floor(pos)); w = pos - l
    return (1-w)*float(x[l]) + w*float(x[l+1])

# validate manual vs numpy on random pools
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
ok = True
for _ in range(200):
    n = rng.integers(1, 300)
    x = rng.normal(size=int(n))
    if n <= 2: continue
    a = hazen_q(x); b = np.quantile(x, 0.9, method='hazen')
    if not np.isclose(a, b, rtol=0, atol=1e-12): ok=False; print("MISMATCH", n, a, b)
print("manual hazen == numpy 'hazen':", ok)

years = list(range(1992,2003))
def center_k(y,d):
    if d<=59: c = dt.date(y,1,1)+dt.timedelta(days=d-1)
    elif d>=61: c = dt.date(y,3,1)+dt.timedelta(days=d-61)
    else: return None
    return int((np.datetime64(c,'D')-base_D).astype(int))

t0=time.time()
thr_raw = np.full((366,60,60), np.nan); clim_raw = np.full((366,60,60), np.nan)
for d in range(1,367):
    if d==60: continue
    ks=[]
    for y in years:
        k = center_k(y,d)
        ks.extend(range(k-5,k+6))
    ks = np.array(sorted(set(ks)))
    pool = basel[ks].reshape(len(ks), -1)
    q = np.empty(pool.shape[1]); m = np.empty(pool.shape[1])
    for j in range(pool.shape[1]):
        col = pool[:,j]
        q[j] = hazen_q(col)
        cc = col[np.isfinite(col)]
        m[j] = cc.mean() if cc.size else np.nan
    thr_raw[d-1] = q.reshape(60,60); clim_raw[d-1] = m.reshape(60,60)
print("manual pool loop %.1fs" % (time.time()-t0))

thr_raw[59] = 0.5*(thr_raw[58]+thr_raw[60]); clim_raw[59] = 0.5*(clim_raw[58]+clim_raw[60])
sidx = (np.arange(366)[:,None] + np.arange(-15,16)[None,:]) % 366
thr_sm2 = thr_raw[sidx].mean(axis=1); clim_sm2 = clim_raw[sidx].mean(axis=1)

saved = np.load('/tmp/mhw_interm.npz')
print("thr_sm identical:", np.array_equal(saved['thr_sm'], thr_sm2, equal_nan=True))
print("clim_sm identical:", np.array_equal(saved['clim_sm'], clim_sm2, equal_nan=True))
print("max |diff| thr:", np.nanmax(np.abs(saved['thr_sm']-thr_sm2)), " clim:", np.nanmax(np.abs(saved['clim_sm']-clim_sm2)))

        if v and s is None: s=i
        if (not v or i==len(h)-1) and s is not None:
            e = i if not v else i+1
            out.append((s,e)); s=None
    return out
